display_long_description:
Can You Save the Pet from the Angry Swarm?

Step into the most addictive drawing puzzle on Meta Horizon! Angry Bee - Protect My Pet challenges your creativity and reflexes in a fully immersive VR world. Your poor pet is in trouble—a hive of angry bees is on the attack, and only your quick thinking (and drawing!) can save the day.

Why You Will Love It:

Creative Drawing Mechanics: Use your VR controllers as a magic pencil to draw lines, walls, and shields in 3D. Every shape you draw reacts to real physics!

Intense Bee Attacks: Watch as the swarm tries to find any gap in your defense. You must hold your shield for 10 seconds to win the level!

Dozens of Brain-Teasing Levels: From simple flat ground to complex floating platforms, every level requires a new strategy to keep the bees away.

Cute & Immersive Visuals: Experience the charm of your pet and the buzz of the bees in a vibrant, high-contrast 3D environment.

Physics-Based Fun: Experiment with different shapes. Sometimes a circle works, but sometimes you need a complex cage to survive the sting!

The bees are coming! Grab your virtual pen, draw your defense, and become the ultimate protector.
